search_scope.accounting: Two protocol slots; one full versioned primary PDF, one inaccessible primary article and its indexed author abstract. Official talk/repository/index pages and incidental search hits are discovery only, not additional admitted physical protocols.

holdout_role: NONE_ADMITTED; no published outcome is called blind or prospective and no physical fitting occurred.

single_missing_input.minimal_first_evidence: An explicit source-native analyzer setting/effect with orientation relative to the conversion coupling on one fixed pre-readout preparation, supported by independent calibration rather than the same Rabi response.
single_missing_input.remaining_packet: Then supply complete detection/normalization/loss/control maps, source-justified joint uncertainty or conservative joint bounds, and separately role-frozen unused outcomes. A covariance matrix is not the only acceptable error representation.
single_missing_input.reentry: A changed-hash actual measurement packet or a precise error in this source reading. An accessible He full paper permits only eligibility assessment, not physical PASS. No equivalent source survey or automatic successor.

research_value: New source-specific eligibility boundary and a narrower preparation reference; no new mathematical theorem and no additional mainline/empirical evidence. Avoids repeating R579 instability, R580 nonclosure or EXCH004 algebra.
verification_scope: Exact-byte/protocol-budget/inference-firewall checks plus separate independent source and hostile wording review. Software checks do not establish experimental absence.
lean: NOT_RUN_NO_NEW_MATHEMATICAL_THEOREM; source/instrument input cannot be supplied by Lean. Existing Lean sources preserved.
non_claims: No conclusion that both physical protocols are impossible or globally no such protocol exists. No actual analyzer calibration, empirical holdout, full P1 identity, EXCH quantization, model/time change, PreA, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum or TOE.
